findings.description: The policy grants ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on Resource "*", which is effectively administrative access across those services (including the ability to read/delete any S3 object, modify any Lambda, or control any EC2 instance) far beyond what a deployment process needs.

A static IAM access key is created for the svc_deploy user; these credentials are long-lived, persist until manually rotated, and are readily exfiltrated from CI systems, contrary to the guidance to prefer federated/temporary credentials.

The encrypted secret of the deploy access key is exported as an output, so the value is stored in Terraform state and any remote backend and is exposed to anyone with read access to state or to plan/apply output.
